title: OBJECTPTR AC1015 direct-writer allocation rollback and retry
scope: Fills the AC1015 ASCII/Binary gap in the existing generated OBJECTPTR transaction matrix, which covers AC1018 through AC1032.

source.provenance: Generated from scratch by the allocation-transaction test adapter in the build-tree scratch directory; generated DXF files are removed after each control.
source.record: One OBJECTPTR at source handle 0xDA70 with parent handle 0xC and no XDATA, reactors, or extension dictionary.

assertions: Every injected allocation failure preserves the prior destination sentinel and leaves no staged output file.
Every injected failure preserves the caller OBJECTPTR handle, parent, reactors, extension-dictionary handle, and XDATA state, and rolls back source-handle/object identity maps.
Retry on the same dxfRW instance reproduces clean baseline bytes exactly.
Fresh ASCII/Binary import reads exactly one OBJECTPTR with the expected handle and parent handle after baseline writes and every retry.

validation.aggregate: The full dxf_write_allocation_transaction suite and broader CTest suite were not rerun.

limits: Generated writer transaction and same-library readback only; producer-authored OBJECTPTR semantics and native consumer behavior are not qualified.
The test checks the parent handle value but does not resolve or qualify the target object's graph closure.
This does not establish DWG OBJECT_PTR output support.
No DWG or DXF fixture file is committed.
